description: Search Scopus publications with its native query syntax. Returns one page of the original Elsevier JSON, including search-results, entry and pagination. Example: TITLE-ABS-KEY(machine learning) AND PUBYEAR > 2020. Credentials come from the server environment. Access to views and cursor pagination depends on your Scopus entitlements.

inputSchema.description: Parameters for one Scopus publication search page. Offset pagination is limited to start + count <= 5000; use cursor to request later pages.

alias.description: Whether author-ID searches include superseded profiles. Omitted values use the API default of true.

content.description: Scopus content collection to search: all, core, or dummy.

count.description: Maximum results in this page. Defaults to 25; up to 200 for STANDARD or 25 for COMPLETE/COMPONENT. With field, Elsevier determines the effective view and limit.

cursor.description: Use * for the first cursor page, then search-results.cursor["@next"] from the previous response. Use instead of start; keep the query and other options unchanged.

date.description: Publication year or inclusive year range, e.g. 2024 or 2020-2024.

field.description: Comma-separated response fields, e.g. identifier,title,doi. Overrides view; omitted fields remain absent in the response.

query.description: Native Scopus publication query, e.g. TITLE-ABS-KEY(machine learning) AND PUBYEAR > 2020.

reqId.description: Caller-supplied request identifier for Elsevier support.

sort.description: Up to three comma-separated sort fields; + ascending, - descending, e.g. -coverDate,+creator.

start.description: Zero-based result offset. Use instead of cursor. The requested window start + count must not exceed 5000; omitted count means 25.

subj.description: Scopus subject area code to filter by, e.g. COMP.

suppressNavLinks.description: Suppress top-level navigation links. Omitted values use the API default of false.

ver.description: Resource version flags: facetexpand, allexpand, new; comma or semicolon separated.

view.description: Response view. Defaults to STANDARD; COMPLETE and COMPONENT require the relevant Scopus entitlements. Overridden by field.

name: scopus_search

outputSchema.description: Unmodified JSON envelope returned by the Scopus Search API.

search-results.description: Native Scopus search response, including page metadata and entries.

cursor.description: Cursor pagination tokens supplied by Elsevier.

@current.description: Cursor identifying the current result page.

@next.description: Cursor to supply unchanged in the next search request.

entry.description: Publication results for this page, or native entry-level messages. Fields depend on view, field selection, and entitlements.

affiliation-url.description: Elsevier API URL for the affiliation profile.

authkeywords.description: Author keywords in the original Elsevier text representation.

author.description: Authors included in the selected response view.

author-url.description: Elsevier API URL for the author profile.

orcid.description: ORCID identifier reported for the author.

citedby-count.description: Citation count, retained as the string returned by Elsevier.

dc:creator.description: Creator name reported for the publication.

dc:description.description: Publication description or abstract, when included in the selected view.

dc:identifier.description: Scopus document identifier, including its SCOPUS_ID prefix when supplied.

eid.description: Scopus electronic identifier (EID) of the document.

error.description: Entry-level message returned by Elsevier, including no-result entries.

@ref.description: Relation of the linked resource, as returned by Elsevier.

openaccess.description: Native open-access indicator, retained as a string.

openaccessFlag.description: Boolean open-access flag, or null when supplied that way by Elsevier.

prism:aggregationType.description: Publication source type, such as Journal.

prism:coverDate.description: Cover date in native Elsevier form: a string, an array of date objects, or null.

prism:doi.description: Digital object identifier (DOI) of the publication.

prism:eIssn.description: Electronic ISSN reported for the source.

prism:issn.description: Print ISSN reported for the source.

prism:pageRange.description: Publication page range as supplied by Elsevier.

prism:publicationName.description: Name of the journal or other publication source.

prism:url.description: Elsevier API URL for the document.

link.description: Response and pagination links supplied by Elsevier.

@ref.description: Relation of the linked resource, as returned by Elsevier.

opensearch:Query.description: OpenSearch metadata for the executed query.

@role.description: Role of the query in the OpenSearch response.

@startPage.description: Starting page reported by Elsevier, retained as a string.

opensearch:itemsPerPage.description: Page size reported by Elsevier, retained as a string.

opensearch:startIndex.description: Zero-based offset of this page, retained as a string.

opensearch:totalResults.description: Total matching publications reported by Elsevier, retained as a string.

title: Scopus Search
